title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up evaluation for chronic kidney disease.

History of Present Illness
The patient presents for routine follow-up regarding their kidney function. They report stable symptoms and deny any acute changes in urination or swelling since the last visit. They understand their diagnosis of chronic kidney disease and are compliant with current management strategies, which include dietary modifications appropriate for someone with stage 3 impairment. They report no new complaints.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10 mg daily
Furosemide 20 mg daily

Physical Exam
Vitals: Blood pressure 130/80 mmHg, heart rate 78 bpm, temperature 98.6°F. Lungs clear to auscultation bilaterally. Abdomen soft and non-tender. Extremities show trace bilateral pitting edema noted at the ankles. Skin assessment is unremarkable.

Assessment
Chronic kidney disease, stage 3. Management remains stable.

Plan
Continue current medications as prescribed. Reinforce dietary restrictions focusing on potassium and phosphorus intake, essential for managing stage 3 impairment. Schedule follow-up in three months, or sooner if symptoms worsen. Patient educated on signs of acute fluid retention.
